title: openai-responses-compat-seed-determinism-metadata-passthrough-v5
author: Maya Chen
description: Backfill OpenAI Responses compatibility: add explicit 'seed' passthrough, deterministic flag handling, metadata passthrough, streaming stability fixes, and improved function/tool-calling structured output support. Motivation: customers using the OpenAI-compatible Responses endpoint expect parity with the upstream Responses API for seed-driven determinism and for arbitrary metadata on responses to be preserved through redwood's compatibility layer. This PR implements seed and deterministic field passthrough (keeping compatibility with existing Redwood model options), retains user-supplied metadata through the adapter and audit logs, and tightens streaming path error handling to avoid partial-stream hangs when tool invocation or structured outputs are returned. Changes include: 1) adapter plumbing to accept and forward 'seed' and 'deterministic' flags to backend model runners while mapping to existing runtime kernel paths; 2) metadata passthrough end-to-end: HTTP -> adapter -> event logs -> response body metadata; 3) structured output improvements to function/tool calling: stronger validation of tool-schema matches, clearer error fallback to text with a structured 'tool_error' object included in metadata; 4) streaming stability: guardrails for premature connection close, backpressure fixes in the compatibility streaming proxy, and an exponential retry for transient upstream stall events; 5) added tests and E2E harness updates; 6) docs and SDK examples updated. Checklist: - [x] implement adapter changes and runtime mapping - [x] unit tests for seed/deterministic and metadata passthrough - [x] e2e streaming test and flaky guard - [x] docs and SDK example updates - [x] performance regression checks (no measurable latency regression in 99th pct under test load). Related: ENG-3241 tracks product acceptance criteria; SUP-1123 is a support case that motivated metadata passthrough for audit compliance. This description contains a concise summary, rationale, and rollout notes.
commits: feat(openai-compat): add seed and deterministic passthrough to responses adapter
fix(streaming): handle upstream stalls and implement retry/backpressure guards
test: add E2E streaming and metadata passthrough tests + unit coverage for function-calling fallback
review_comments: Arjun: Can you confirm the interaction between deterministic flag and runtime quantization path? We should avoid forcing different kernel selection at runtime unless explicitly pinned.

Maya: replied - deterministic is forwarded as a soft hint to the seed manager; kernel selection unchanged unless the model variant config requests it. Added an integration test to validate no kernel switch under default configs.
Eve: LGTM but please add a small doc note about metadata size limits and implications for audit logs.
Maya: added docs note in docs/openai_compat.md and SDK examples; clarified truncation behavior and 64KB recommended metadata limit.
Diego: CI flaky test failed once due to e2e network timeouts; re-run cleared. Please include a retry wrapper for the streaming e2e harness.
Maya: added exponential backoff retry in ci/scripts/flaky_retry.sh and increased test robustness; reran CI and all checks passed.
release_notes: Add OpenAI Responses compatibility: seed and deterministic flags are now accepted and forwarded; response.metadata is preserved end-to-end; improved streaming stability for responses containing function/tool calls; SDK examples updated. No breaking changes to existing Redwood API. Recommend customers upgrading private installers to include runtime/seed_manager updates.
notes_for_ops: Rollout plan: deploy adapter change to canary cluster first with traffic shaping 1%. Observe streaming error rates and 99th pct latency for 24h. If stable, increase to 10% then full rollout. Backout: revert to previous adapter binary which ignores seed/metadata passthrough while retaining streaming guard. Special attention: audit logs will begin to include user metadata fields; ensure downstream log retention and PII filtering policies are applied.
human_readable_summary: Merged PR that brings Responses API parity improvements: seed/deterministic passthrough, metadata passthrough into audit logs and response bodies, streaming stability fixes, and improved function/tool calling structured output handling. Includes tests, docs, and SDK updates.
